Home.discoverP1: Crossway Hotels & Resorts was created to redefine modern hospitality in India, offering premium hotel stays, boutique experiences, and personalized service across carefully chosen destinations.
Home.discoverP2: Our teams are trained to deliver warm, attentive, and intuitive hospitality, ensuring every guest experiences more than just a stay. We position you in strategic locations—close to business hubs, coastal retreats, and lifestyle destinations—while maintaining uncompromising standards of comfort.
Home.discoverP3: From modern interiors and restful sleep experiences to rejuvenating spas and curated dining, every Crossway property is designed to deliver a stay that feels considered, seamless, and memorable.

PerfectStayInsights.modalLead: Each tile is a thread—open one to read the full story on its own page.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodationsModalLead: Every Crossway hotel—tap a property to open the full accommodations guide with room types, locations, and booking.
PerfectStayInsights.meetingsModalLead: Meetings and celebrations at The Palomar and Crossway Days Hotel—tap a property to explore venues, capacities, and event formats.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_palomar_spa_tagline: Sea-near calm on ECR—ritual baths, slow massage, and rooms that exhale with you.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_palomar_spa_body: The Palomar spa is built as a sequence of quiet chambers: thermal contrast, herbal compress, and therapists trained to read pace, not pressure.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_palomar_spa_body2: Bookend a coastal day with twilight soak rituals and breakfast menus tuned for hydration and clarity.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_days_thermal_suite_tagline: Business-travel rhythm, spa-grade recovery—steam, ice, and sleep-forward suites.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_days_thermal_suite_body: Padur’s pace asks for contrast therapy and unbroken sleep. Our thermal suite pairs with extended check-out windows when meetings run long.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_days_thermal_suite_body2: Use the circuit before flights or after road time—the sequence is short enough for real itineraries, deep enough to matter.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_lifotel_calm_studio_tagline: Essentials-first stays with in-room breath space and guided wind-down.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_lifotel_calm_studio_body: Lifotel’s calm studio layer adds low-light zones, scent-free options, and a focused menu of chair massage and stretch sessions.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_lifotel_calm_studio_body2: Ideal when you want restoration without a full resort day—book 45 minutes, keep your evening open.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_ayurveda_ritual_tagline: Dosha-aware oils, herbal steam, and therapists who honour traditional sequence.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_ayurveda_ritual_body: A multi-step ritual that moves from warm oil to herbal poultice, closing with quiet tea and a personalized after-care note.
PerfectStayInsights.wellness_ayurveda_ritual_body2: We keep groups small and slots limited so every session keeps its unhurried shape.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_connecting_suites_tagline: Door-between privacy with shared living—bedtimes and movie nights, solved.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_connecting_suites_body: Pair a king with a twin room or junior suite so adults decompress while younger guests settle on their own clock.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_connecting_suites_body2: Our teams stage cribs, extra keys, and staggered housekeeping so the day stays yours.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_kids_weekend_club_tagline: Facilitated games, safe outdoor loops, and parents-off coffee windows.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_kids_weekend_club_body: Weekend mornings open with supervised craft and lawn games while parents enjoy an unbroken breakfast.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_kids_weekend_club_body2: Advance sign-up keeps ratios calm; every slot ends with a hand-off note so you know what sparked joy.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_pool_lawn_days_tagline: Shaded decks, shallow hours, and service that anticipates splash-and-snack cycles.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_pool_lawn_days_body: Lifeguarded pools, towel stations, and menus that understand hungry swimmers.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_pool_lawn_days_body2: Lawn cinema and low-key acoustic evenings rotate seasonally—ask the desk for the week’s rhythm.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_family_dining_table_tagli: Large-format plates, gentle spice, and high chairs without the fuss.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_family_dining_table_body: Chefs set a shared table with grills, breads, and desserts that land at once so no one waits staring.
PerfectStayInsights.accommodations_family_dining_table_body2: Dietary notes travel to the pass; kids’ portions stay generous, not apologetic.
PerfectStayInsights.business_executive_lounge_tagline: Print, coffee, and call booths—quiet enough for real decisions.
PerfectStayInsights.business_executive_lounge_body: Morning pastries shift to evening savouries; desks stay spaced for focus, not spectacle.
PerfectStayInsights.business_executive_lounge_body2: Hosts track car calls and courier hand-offs so you never repeat your itinerary at the desk.
PerfectStayInsights.business_meeting_floors_omr_tagline: Daylight rooms, wired tables, and catering that respects clock time.
PerfectStayInsights.business_meeting_floors_omr_body: Boardrooms scale from 8 to 120 with breakout pockets and technician-on-call blocks.
PerfectStayInsights.business_meeting_floors_omr_body2: Hybrid kits ship with labels and spare adapters—walk in, plug in, present.
PerfectStayInsights.business_airport_rhythm_tagline: Staggered pickups, luggage-first arrivals, and lobby teams who read flight codes.
PerfectStayInsights.business_airport_rhythm_body: We coordinate with approved transport partners and keep night arrivals frictionless.
PerfectStayInsights.business_airport_rhythm_body2: Early departures get packed breakfasts and silent floors—no surprise housekeeping knocks.
PerfectStayInsights.business_quiet_desk_suites_tagline: Ergonomic chairs, task light, and acoustic seals for deep-work nights.
PerfectStayInsights.business_quiet_desk_suites_body: Suites add a dedicated work wall, extra outlets, and blackout layers for screen-fatigued eyes.
PerfectStayInsights.business_quiet_desk_suites_body2: Housekeeping can skip daytime turndown on request—your flow stays intact.
PerfectStayInsights.food_ecr_seafood_room_tagline: Catch-led plates, coconut broths, and grills that respect the coast.
PerfectStayInsights.food_ecr_seafood_room_body: Chefs buy daily and plate simply—lime, curry leaf, and heat as accent, not armour.
PerfectStayInsights.food_ecr_seafood_room_body2: Pair with a mineral-forward wine list or a jasmine iced tea flight built for humidity.
PerfectStayInsights.food_omr_coffee_house_tagline: Single-origin pulls, slow cold brew, and savouries for between-meeting gaps.
PerfectStayInsights.food_omr_coffee_house_body: Baristas dial recipes each morning; pastries arrive in small batches through the day.
PerfectStayInsights.food_omr_coffee_house_body2: Grab a corner booth for video calls—outlets and acoustic panels included.
PerfectStayInsights.food_roof_grill_nights_tagline: Smoke, ember vegetables, and skyline breeze after humid days.
PerfectStayInsights.food_roof_grill_nights_body: Skewers and flatbreads roll out as the sun drops; playlists stay low so conversation wins.
PerfectStayInsights.food_roof_grill_nights_body2: Reserve for anniversaries or closing dinners—chefs will stage a coursed fire menu.
PerfectStayInsights.food_chef_table_palomar_tagline: Counter seats, tasting scripts, and wine bridges narrated in plain language.
PerfectStayInsights.food_chef_table_palomar_body: Eight to ten courses move through Tamil spice arcs and modern technique without theatrics.
PerfectStayInsights.food_chef_table_palomar_body2: Dietary arcs are rewritten, not removed—tell us once, we choreograph around it.

BrandCrossway.title: CROSSWAY HOTELS AND RESORTS
BrandCrossway.subtitle: Upperscale / Luxury Brand
BrandCrossway.p1: Crossway Hotels and Resorts was established to redefine the paradigm of hospitality and service culture. We offer our customers with a comfortable stay and relaxing atmosphere at our hotels. Our skilled and trained staffs are trained to deliver a warm, attentive and a personalized service to every customer. We go beyond just offering a comfortable stay. We create our hotels that offer our guests with the best location possible with an uncompromising service. With vibrant locations come our distinctive features that makes our guest’s stay more delightful with modern interiors with a great bed and shower experience, rejuvenating spas and exceptional food and beverages selections.
BrandCrossway.p2: An extraordinary brand for the extraordinary you! This brand is the perfect blend of service and luxury. Our staff here are well-trained to provide every guest with personal attention and offer all them with the best of service. The luxury feel, the interiors, the service, and the amenities, everything about this Signature brand will leave you guests in a mesmerizing state.

BrandLifotel.title: Lifotel By Crossway
BrandLifotel.subtitle: Wellness Life Style Brand
BrandLifotel.p1: Lifotel is a concept that brings one closer to living life the natural way without Alcohol! Lifotel is one place that will relax your mind in the true sense and offer you with a serene atmosphere to work and spend quality time with your loved ones.
BrandLifotel.p2: Lifotel is a collection of hotels and resorts with the objective to promote customers to stay here and celebrate life in the right way either with your family or your colleagues. It helps individuals to spend time away from the monotonous life, it gives the guests the time to involve in physical activities, fitness exercises, nutritious foods and healthy drinks.
BrandLifotel.p3: Here, we offer the right space, the calm surrounding and the perfect atmosphere to relax, unwind and re energize oneself. Our Signature Spas will help to rejuvenate and bring back our guest’s balance in place. It is a great place to host events and meetings to celebrate life and also to help an organisation to take key decisions in an alcohol free environment.

BrandLifotelSuites.title: Lifotel Suites
BrandLifotelSuites.subtitle: Non Alcoholic Serviced Residences
BrandLifotelSuites.p1: Lifotel Suites are serviced residences situated at great locations . These suites are built with modern and contemporary interiors, to offer our guests a feeling of being at home. Come here and relax to make your holiday or business trips more homely, as we provide you with spacious rooms, quality living, cooking space and laundry services. A perfect place to live and feel the warmth of being at home! Recommended for longer stays as well.

BrandRevostay.title: REVOSTAY BY CROSSWAY
BrandRevostay.subtitle: Extended Stay & Lifestyle Brand
BrandRevostay.p1: Revostay by Crossway brings together thoughtfully designed extended-stay residences and hotels for travellers who want space, consistency, and the freedom to settle into a rhythm—whether you are on assignment, relocating, or simply staying longer to explore the city.
BrandRevostay.p2: From practical suites with kitchen convenience to warm service that respects your independence, Revostay properties are built around longer visits: smarter layouts, dependable amenities, and locations that keep you connected to what matters. Discover stays that feel less like a nightly checkout—and more like home along the way.

Team.prakash_bio_0: A hospitality professional with more than 25+ years of experience in the entire gamut of Hotel operations and good academic and professional experience in reputed 5-star hotels and resorts in India, Africa and Middle East.
Team.prakash_bio_1: As a hospitality professional he has been responsible for opening properties like Le Royal Meridien Chennai and Commonwealth Resort Convention Centre, Uganda, Africa. He also been a key participant in key training programmes like Leadership skills conducted by INCON Consultants, Dubai and HACCP course accredited by Royal Institute of Public Health, UK.
Team.prakash_bio_2: Prakash has opened Days Hotel Chennai OMR, a Wyndham hotel and Ramada Chennai Egmore, Prakash has worked with Makaseb Group, Saudi Arabia , responsible for 50 plus hotels in Saudi Arabia and GCC countries.
Team.prakash_bio_3: Prakash with his Crossway Hospitality Services sine 2013 has been involved in consulting huge number of projects and also managing properties like Days Hotel Chennai ,Saaral Residency,KKinn etc.
Team.sulekha_bio_0: A Hotel Management Graduate with 20+ years of experience, 14 years expertise in Rooms Division and 3 years in Hotel Operations. She hails from the Andaman Nicobar Islands and has working experience in reputed 5 star hotels in various cities across India.
Team.sulekha_bio_1: Sulekha has been a part of Preopening teas with Days Hotel Chennai OMR as Operations Manager; Front Office Manager Preopening / rebranding – Ramada Chennai Egmore; Front Office Manager Preopening- Matthan Hotel Bangalore and Front Office Manager Preopening- Oakwood Premier Prestige Bangalore.
Team.sulekha_bio_2: In addition she has worked with The Zuri White Sands Goa Resort & Casino; The Lalit Grand Palace Srinagar; Royal Orchid Hotels, The Park Chennai , Taj Connemara Chennai and Savera Hotel Chennai.
